name: TTK Prestige Limited
summary: TTK Prestige Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells kitchen and home appliances under the Prestige and Judge brands in India and internationally. The company offers pressure cookers; cookware; cooking appliances, such as gas stoves, induction/infrared cooktops, rice cookers, OTG, and air fryers; food preparation products, including mixers and wet grinders, hand blenders, hand mixers, electric choppers, and grain grinders; and breakfast and snacks products comprising toasters, kettles, juicers, coffee makers, egg boilers, and yogurt makers.
